title: Estimating Exam Item Difficulty with LLMs: A Benchmark on Brazil’s ENEM Corpus

bias_targets.methodology: Injecting country-specific context cues (e.g., "students in {Country}") into prompts for exam item difficulty estimation and measuring systematic shifts (signed residuals) in predicted difficulty across seven different countries compared to IRT ground truth.

Evaluating whether large language models exhibit systematic location or scale biases in difficulty predictions when conditioned on different geographic locations (countries) representing distinct student populations.
